name: Nginx Proxy Manager
description: Exposez vos services avec des certificats Let's Encrypt en quelques clics.
notes: AzmoOS occupe le port 80 : NPM écoute sur 8880 (HTTP) et 4443 (HTTPS), changez si besoin. Identifiants : admin@example.com / changeme
compose:
services:
  npm:
    image: jc21/nginx-proxy-manager:latest
    container_name: npm
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8880:80"
      - "4443:443"
      - "81:81"
    volumes:
      - {{APPDATA}}/data:/data
      - {{APPDATA}}/letsencrypt:/etc/letsencrypt
